latest_cos_commentary.headline: Spectrum Business is Charter Communications' business connectivity arm, marketing dedicated fiber internet, unified communications, and managed network services specifically to restaurant operators for POS reliability and order-continuity.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Does not compete with Genius's POS or payments software; competes for the underlying network/connectivity layer that Genius's POS and payment terminals depend on, so unreliable competing connectivity providers can indirectly affect Genius uptime perception at a site.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No recent restaurant-specific product launch or acquisition news identified in this research pass.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Not a direct product competitor; relevant mainly in the context of network/connectivity reliability conversations, where a poor ISP experience (with Spectrum or a rival) can be mistakenly attributed to POS/payments performance.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Sourced case study does not name the specific restaurant chain involved; avoid citing it as a named-customer proof point.
